title: ChoreoStudio: Planning What, When, and Who in Music-Driven Group Choreography
title_zh: ChoreoStudio：在音乐驱动的群舞编舞中规划什么、何时以及谁来

paragraphs.en: ChoreoStudio将音乐驱动群舞编舞的队形、时机与执行者决策显式化，取得最先进的群舞生成性能。 Music-driven group dance generation must decide not only how each dancer moves, but also what formation the group should form, when it should change, and who should execute each transition. Existing methods can generate orderly and rhythmically synchronized group motion, but remain limited in formation evolution and inter-dancer interaction. In human choreography, formation transitions often align with changes in high-level musical structure, such as the progression from an introduction to a chorus or from a chorus to a climax. We present ChoreoStudio, which makes choreography planning explicit. A music disentangler first decomposes the audio into frame-level rhythmic features and segment-level structural features. Given the segment-level features and sparse labels, a frozen omni-modal model acts as a scriptwriter, producing a global semantic description that guides the Director's choreography planning. Based on this context, the Director produces three coupled interaction decisions: a centroid-relative point set specifies what formation to produce, a transition gate determines when it should change, and a mobility allocation indicates who should execute the transition. The transition gate and mobility allocation are further conditioned on the planned geometric change, coupling formation targets with their temporal and dancer-specific execution. At a finer temporal scale, frame-aligned music features condition the diffusion generator to control detailed body motion and preserve beat-level alignment. The segment-level interaction plan is injected in parallel through frame-aligned instruction tokens and cross-dancer attention biases, coordinating how the generator realizes each transition. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChoreoStudio follows the planned interactions while achieving state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, group organization, and formation dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: ChoreoStudio 将音乐驱动群舞编舞中的队形、时机与执行者决策显式化，取得了最先进的群舞生成性能。音乐驱动的群舞生成不仅要决定每位舞者如何动作，还要决定群体应形成何种队形、何时变换队形，以及应由谁来执行每次变换。 现有方法能够生成有序且节奏同步的群体动作，但在队形演化与舞者间交互方面仍存在局限。 在人类编舞中，队形变换往往与高层音乐结构的变化相契合，例如从主歌到副歌、或从副歌到高潮的推进过程。 我们提出 ChoreoStudio，它将编舞规划显式化。 音乐解缠器首先将音频分解为帧级节奏特征与段落级结构特征。 基于段落级特征和稀疏标签，一个冻结的全模态模型充当编剧，生成全局语义描述，以引导导演的编舞规划。 在该上下文的基础上，导演产出三个相互耦合的交互决策：一个以质心为参照的点集规定生成何种队形，一个变换门控决定何时变换队形，一个移动性分配指示由谁执行该变换。 变换门控与移动性分配进一步以规划好的几何变化为条件，将队形目标与其时间维度及舞者特定的执行方式耦合起来。 在更精细的时间尺度上，与帧对齐的音乐特征对扩散生成器进行条件化，以控制精细的身体动作并保持节拍级对齐。 段落级交互计划通过帧对齐的指令 token 和跨舞者注意力偏置并行注入，协调生成器如何实现每次变换。 在 AIOZ-GDance 上的实验表明，ChoreoStudio 在遵循规划交互的同时，在动作质量、群体组织和队形动态方面取得了最先进的性能。
